approved_by: user, 2026-10-08 ('Approved lets test it'), as drafted, before any flow-to-return relationship was examined
inputs: nn_meta/validation/v9-ove1-20261008-r0/flow.parquet (scripts/build_v9_ove_flow.py); V8 bars and admission (V8_CONTRACT_20261008.json); V8 option chains; OEE-0 events and OEE-H4 legs for the earnings family
signal_timing: flow is the day's OPRA aggregate, known after the close of day t. Stock trades enter at the open of t+1 (V8 stock fill model, nn_meta.v8_fills, 09:30 snapshot cell); option trades enter at the close of t+1 (a one-day lag, conservative)
normalization: abnormal(x)_t = (ln(1 + x_t) - mean) / std of ln(1 + x) over the ticker's previous 20 trading days (t-20 .. t-1); NaN with fewer than 15 days or zero std
noise_filters: applied to every non-earnings variant: stock tech names only (no ETFs); admitted by the V8 liquidity rule on day t; |stock return on t| < 3%; no earnings reaction within the last 2 or next 5 trading days; flow day t has >= 50 option prints

family_A_unusual_flow.A1_otm_call_buying_stock: abnormal(st_otm_call_prem) >= 2 and st_otm_call_prem / (st_otm_call_prem + st_otm_put_prem) >= 0.65 → long stock, exit at the close of t+5
family_A_unusual_flow.A2_otm_call_buying_call: A1's signal → buy the 0.5-delta call of the nearest expiry with 5-21 DTE at the close of t+1 (traded that day), exit at the close of t+5 (the contract's close; intrinsic if it expired; otherwise dropped and counted)
family_A_unusual_flow.A3_otm_put_buying_put: mirror of A1 with puts (abnormal(st_otm_put_prem) >= 2, put share >= 0.65) → buy the 0.5-delta put as in A2
family_A_unusual_flow.A4_aggressive_block_calls_stock: abnormal(block_call_vol) >= 2 and st_otm_call_prem_at_high / st_otm_call_prem >= 0.5 → long stock to the close of t+5

family_B_dark_pool.B1_dix_long: finra_short_ratio on day t in the top decile of the ticker's previous 60 trading days (the DIX reading: high off-exchange short volume = dealers filling buyers) → long stock to the close of t+5
family_B_dark_pool.B2_flow_plus_dix: A1's signal with B1 also true on t or t-1 → long stock to the close of t+5

family_E_earnings_flow.question: Does options buying in the week before earnings point the reaction's direction (informed pre-earnings trading)?
family_E_earnings_flow.feature: imbalance = (sum st_otm_call_prem - sum st_otm_put_prem) / (sum of both) over the 5 trading days ending the OEE entry day (E-4 .. E), using flow known by E's close; trailing terciles as OEE
family_E_earnings_flow.E1_flow_atm_option: OEE events (admission and pricing as V9_OEE1_PREREG_20261008.json): top tercile → buy the 0.5-delta call, bottom → the 0.5-delta put (exactly the H1 trade with this score)
family_E_earnings_flow.E2_flow_otm_leg: same sides on the 10% OTM leg (OEE-H4 legs, pricing as V9_OEE_H4_PREREG_20261008.json)
family_E_earnings_flow.E3_flow_stock: top tercile → long stock from the entry close to the reaction close; bottom → no trade (V8 shorts failed); V8 stock fill model

costs: stock: nn_meta.v8_fills (m = 1.0, stress 1.5); options: half the V8 spread-model bucket median per leg (k = 1.0, stress 1.5) + $0.05 per contract per side
overlap: per-trade evaluation; a ticker cannot re-enter the same variant while its previous trade is open

evaluation.dev: signal days 2022-03-01 .. 2025-12-31 for families A and B (2021-2022 Q1 supplies the trailing windows); family E as OEE (2023-01-01 .. 2025-12-31)
evaluation.folds: half-years by signal day: A/B 2022H1 (from March) .. 2025H2 (8 folds); E the OEE six folds
evaluation.variant_family: 9 variants (A1-A4, B1-B2, E1-E3); Holm across the 9

pass_all_required_in_dev.edge: mean net per-trade return > 0 at cost 1.0 with t >= 2, standard errors clustered by signal day
pass_all_required_in_dev.folds: mean positive in >= 2/3 of the folds
pass_all_required_in_dev.cost_stress: mean > 0 with clustered t >= 2 at cost 1.5

evaluation.reported_not_gating: trade counts, hit rate, payoff quantiles, return vs the equal-weight admitted universe over the same days (stock variants), E-family sign accuracy
evaluation.confirmation: 2026-01-02 .. 2026-09-14 for dev passes only (B family needs FINRA 2026 fetched first); pass = mean > 0 with clustered t >= 1 at cost 1.0
evaluation.single_run: dev runs once and is reported whatever the outcome

forward_data: the OVE-0 open-interest recorder (from 2026-10-08) is not used here; opening-vs-closing OI tests need months of forward data and get their own pre-registration
limitations: daily aggregates cannot tell buyer- from seller-initiated volume; 'closing near the high' is a proxy
premium dollars use last-trade closes, not trade-weighted prices
FINRA short volume includes market-maker hedging; the DIX reading is a hypothesis, not a fact

implementation_clarifications.note: fixed at freeze, before any result
implementation_clarifications.folds_pass: A/B: >= 6 of the 8 half-year folds (2/3 rounded up); E: >= 4 of 6
implementation_clarifications.e_family_cluster: the E family's signal day is the OEE entry day
implementation_clarifications.option_expiry_before_exit: an A2/A3 contract that expires before t+5 exits at intrinsic value from the raw close on its expiry day
implementation_clarifications.e1_pricing: E1 reuses OEE-2's call50/put50 legs with reaction-day expiries at intrinsic (scripts/run_v9_oee2.py expiry_day_intrinsic)
implementation_clarifications.stock_fills: entry at the open uses the 09:45 cost cell, exits at the close use the 15:45 cell (nn_meta.v8_fills.stock_half_spread_bps); sells pay 0.3 bp fees
